notes.title: Update Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed issues with publishing user stories.
Fixed a bug where advisors' influence could exceed 100.
Fixed a number of minor bugs.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and the list of changes!
notes.notes:
Hey Dark Lords!

We are happy to share some great news – we are taking part in Steam Next Fest, which is taking place from February 5 to 12!

Surely, we couldn’t arrive at the festival empty-handed. Here’s the list of changes we implemented for the game!


 Added new images for the choice cards for more visual variety in cards and wider creative possibilities for you in the future!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742537/66948aa7da3c0c08399191641df2418067f73f25.jpg
 Made advisors animated. They’ve never been more alive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742537/96edbf7fde1c6efbf50e8ed2092aeb9815c1df61.gif

 Added a set of emotions for the advisors. We don’t want any miscommunication with them, are we?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742537/343ec23718568b598e5c632792e213868403b715.jpg
 Added a special directory for user stories. At the moment, the functionality is launched in a test mode and the amount of stories is limited. After the release, players will be able to create their own stories through the built-in editor and publish them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742537/07f7db8316e1a65d4ea8189636bd82152e58c7b1.jpg
 Added the main screen from where you can go to the campaign or the stories catalog.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742537/3d3a50669d5b0605dcefdc6b1653ec92c982a08f.gif
 Bug fixes.

Now, by order of the Dark Lord, all minions and aspiring overlords, try the updated demo version of our game and check out special custom stories we prepared for you!

Add Dark Lord to your wishlist, leave your sinister reviews, join our Discord server, and spread the word in your dark circles!
